name: Should I use interior or exterior paint for my remodel?

mainEntity.name: Should I use interior or exterior paint for my remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior and exterior paints are formulated differently to suit their respective environments. Interior paints are designed for durability against wear and tear, and often prioritize low odor and easy cleanup, while exterior paints are built to withstand harsh weather conditions, UV rays, and temperature fluctuations. Using the correct type of paint is crucial for longevity and performance. Never use interior paint outside, and vice-versa, as it will not provide the necessary protection or finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use interior paint for indoor projects and exterior paint for outdoor projects, as they are formulated for different environmental demands and durability.
